summary: No qualifying sponsors. After applying executed amendments (which move R1659/R4622/R8409/R9231/R7166/R6294/R9475 to Seattle) and the R8409 team-page update, and after disregarding the unsigned draft on R7166 and the post-cutoff team-page update on R9231 and the post-cutoff R4391 publication, every remaining Dallas Industrial record fails at least one rule: former employment (R4342), stale verification (R9787), excluded role (R1915 Registered Agent), excluded firm_kind (R8222 manager, R8993 broker), sub-$8M size (R1794), out-of-window event (R2755), announced bid (R4936), wrong asset type (R7745), portfolio total (R8586), and Seattle base market (R4732). R3050 is also a duplicate of R1659. Insufficient evidence to name any qualifying sponsor.
limitations: Evaluation is bound to the supplied packet only; no external lookups, CRM, or enrichment were used.
